SELECT COALESCE(dispatch_id, id) AS dispatchId, MIN(id) AS primaryTaskId, COUNT(*) AS memberCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS runningCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS finishedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelledCount, MIN(create_time) AS dispatchTime, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 1 WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = COUNT(*) THEN 3 ELSE 2 END AS status FROM flow_task
AND task_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{taskName}, '%')
GROUP BY COALESCE(dispatch_id, id)
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = COUNT(*)
ORDER BY MIN(create_time) DESC, MIN(id) DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT COALESCE(dispatch_id, id) FROM flow_task
AND task_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{taskName}, '%')
GROUP BY COALESCE(dispatch_id, id)
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = COUNT(*)
) d

SELECT t.* FROM flow_task t INNER JOIN ( SELECT COALESCE(dispatch_id, id) AS dispatch_id, MIN(id) AS mid FROM flow_task WHERE COALESCE(dispatch_id, id) IN #{d} GROUP BY COALESCE(dispatch_id, id) ) g ON t.id = g.mid

SELECT t.id AS taskId, t.task_name AS taskName, t.template_id AS templateId, t.status, t.current_node_id AS currentNodeId, t.current_handler_id AS currentHandlerId, t.finished_node_count AS finishedNodeCount, t.total_node_count AS totalNodeCount, t.create_time AS createTime, s.handler_user_id AS ownerUserId, u.real_name AS ownerName, u.emp_no AS ownerEmpNo, u.dept_name AS ownerDept, -- 当前处理人 = 当前节点的全部待办处理人（任一完成即可）；无待办时回退为当前指针处理人 CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM flow_task_node tn3 WHERE tn3.task_id = t.id AND tn3.node_id = t.current_node_id AND tn3.submit_status = 0) THEN (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(u3.real_name SEPARATOR '、') FROM flow_task_node tn3 LEFT JOIN sys_user u3 ON u3.id = tn3.handler_user_id WHERE tn3.task_id = t.id AND tn3.node_id = t.current_node_id AND tn3.submit_status = 0) ELSE cu.real_name END AS currentHandlerName, cn.node_name AS currentNodeName FROM flow_task t JOIN flow_task_node s ON s.node_type = 1 AND s.id = (SELECT MIN(id) FROM flow_task_node WHERE task_id = t.id AND node_type = 1) LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = s.handler_user_id LEFT JOIN sys_user cu ON cu.id = t.current_handler_id LEFT JOIN flow_template_node cn ON cn.id = t.current_node_id WHERE COALESCE(t.dispatch_id, t.id) = #{dispatchId} ORDER BY t.id ASC
